basis: CD40L immunodeficiency; intrinsic neutropenia in ~63% and recurrent oral ulcers in ~45%. Opportunistic infections are separate diseases; individual hepatic complications are <30%.
Developmental impairment of speech or language; hearing damage is not characteristic across this umbrella.
Oxidative phosphorylation disorder; developmental impairment in 2/3, cardiomyopathy/heart failure in 1/3 and retinal degeneration in 1/3. Estimates rely on very small cohorts.
Degenerative disease of knee articular cartilage and joint structures.
Tumour of developing sympathetic neural tissue outside the brain; no additional organ of origin applies consistently across sites.
Bartholin gland is a female reproductive organ, outside the specified axes; infection is not inherent to this umbrella.
Inherited pyrophosphate metabolism/mineralization disorder causing cartilage crystal deposition and chronic arthropathy.
Ependymal tumour arising in the brain stem.
Optic hypoplasia 11/12, scoliosis 5/5 with contractures, and hearing impairment 4/5. Precocious puberty omitted by cap; respiratory weakness/infections do not establish lung damage.
Recurrent oral ulcers are defining; skin lesions and uveitis commonly affect >30%. Vascular and joint involvement omitted by cap; severe CNS disease is clinically usually <30%.
CRTAP-related bone fragility with recurrent fractures and skeletal deformities; blue sclerae alone do not establish ocular damage.
Gluconeogenesis defect characterized by hypoglycemia and hepatic steatosis/failure. Renal steatosis alone does not establish functional kidney damage.
Hydrocephalus causes gait and cognitive dysfunction; incontinence reflects neurologic dysfunction rather than direct urinary or bowel damage.
SYP-related nonsyndromic intellectual developmental disorder; occasional seizures affect the same axis.
Autoantibody-mediated neuromuscular junction dysfunction; bulbar and respiratory weakness do not establish separate mucosal or lung damage.
Excess lacrimation is a disorder of the ocular lacrimal apparatus.
Benign intracranial choroid plexus tumour, commonly causing hydrocephalus. Visual impairment is occasional; osteosarcoma is a separate tumour.
Lysosomal cystine storage with defining nephropathy; corneal disease in 80-99%, with photophobia and ocular pain indicating functional involvement. Hypothyroidism is <30%.
Benign cutaneous proliferation of keratinocytes and melanocytes.
Autoimmune skin and muscle inflammation; vasculitis reported in 30-79%. Restriction can reflect muscle weakness; pulmonary fibrosis and intrinsic heart disease are <30%.
Mitochondrial complex I disorder defined by optic nerve dysfunction and atrophy; optic nerve involvement belongs to the ocular axis.
Craniosynostosis and limb anomalies define it; Chiari malformation 80-99%, airway malformations and auditory canal atresia 30-79%. Visual loss <30%; proptosis alone is insufficient.
FLAD1-related metabolic lipid-storage myopathy. Respiratory insufficiency reflects muscle weakness; cardiomyopathy and arrhythmia are reported in <30%.
Carcinoma originates in hypopharyngeal epithelium; the specified pulmonary axis includes the pharynx.
Meckel syndrome is defined by cystic renal dysplasia, CNS malformations and polydactyly; hepatic ductal-plate malformation with fibrosis is common (>30%).
